word_family.translation: to take a text or idea apart to reveal its hidden assumptions
the critical method of analysing a text by exposing its internal contradictions
relating to the practice of exposing hidden contradictions in a text
to build something again from its parts, or to rebuild an argument

sentence: The essay's ______ of the text's binary oppositions exposed assumptions the author had never acknowledged. (deconstruct)
explanation: We need a noun naming the critical method applied to the text. The suffix -ion creates a noun from the verb 'deconstruct'.
